pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.
   C. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   C. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   D. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.
   C. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Retention of Islamic values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Shia Beliefs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain World Religions: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. C — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. A — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Retention of Islamic values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Shia Beliefs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim Scholars; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of World Religions:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
